title: INITIALIZE TypeScript Backend Environment and Bundling Setup
content:
**What**: Converted Express application entrypoints to TypeScript (`src/app.ts` and `src/server.ts`) with strict `tsconfig.json` and dual ESM/CJS build target (`tsup`).
**Why**: Establishes type safety, autocompletion and compile-time error detection for the backend API layer.
**Where**: `src/app.ts`, `src/server.ts`, `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`.
**Learned**: Using `tsx watch src/server.ts` for development provides instantaneous API reloading without needing nodemon or intermediate compilation steps.
